**Feedback:** Failure. YouTube blocked the IP (cloud-provider / too many requests). Suggested proxies or cookies.

**Turn 3.** Agent: *“The transcript API is blocked. Let me try to navigate to the YouTube video directly…”*  
Call: `playwright_with_chunk-browser_navigate` to the same `ovwwehTpaK8` URL.

**Feedback:** Click succeeded. Snapshot now 11 spans. Description begins to expand: Spotify line, date **Oct 10, 2025**, 19,382 views. Bot-signin overlay still present. Description still truncated in span 1.

**Turn 7.** Agent: *“The description is now expanded. Let me navigate through the spans…”*  
Call: `browser_snapshot_navigate_to_next_span`.

**Feedback:** Span 2 of 11 — full **Tracklist** for `ovwwehTpaK8` (Helions Cover / Slap House), songs 1–14, e.g. Not Your Barbie Girl, We Don’t Talk Anymore, Kings and Queen, Rockabye, Prayer In C, Doll House, Let Me Down Slowly, The Motto, Attention, Locked Out Of Heaven, House Of Memories, Thank You, 7 Years, Safari.

Call: another `browser_snapshot_navigate_to_next_span`.

**Feedback:** Span 3 of 11 — songs 15–22: Zombie, Ghost, Cheating On You, Sorry, Madonna, Cool Kids, I Love You 3000, Mama Said, Forever Young. Chapters UI repeats the same names. Copyright: HongAn Entertainment.

Call: `local-claim_done`.
